cases.subject: file pick previews without applying
cases.given: a .json file picked in the import dialog
cases.expected: the E0 preview reads and classifies it; the current document is unchanged; Commit is a separate gesture

cases.subject: paste channel previews pasted text
cases.given: chart text pasted into the import dialog
cases.expected: the same preview pipeline with channel paste; the classification row names the detected format

cases.subject: format hints follow the frozen vocabulary
cases.expected: exactly auto, canonical-json, legacy-json, chart-text; auto is the default; an unknown hint refuses before dispatch

cases.subject: legacy import report groups in frozen order
cases.given: a legacy JSON payload with preserved, canonicalized, custom, ignored, and rejected items
cases.expected: the report renders groups in the order preserved, canonicalized, custom, ignored, rejected with per-group counts and the first-256 retention policy

cases.subject: the report never drops refusals
cases.expected: every refusal appears with its code verbatim; a preview that hides refusals is a contract violation

cases.subject: chart text routes to insert-only quick entry
cases.expected: the dialog routes to quick entry insertion and says so; replacement is not offered for text

cases.subject: commit rides the replacement confirmation
cases.given: a ready canonical-json preview over a dirty current chart
cases.expected: Commit opens the replacement confirmation with origin canonical-import; confirming rides the stop-and-swap; the import never bypasses §4

cases.subject: discard abandons the preview
cases.expected: the draft clears via set-import-draft null; nothing applies; focus restores

cases.subject: refused input preserves the current chart
cases.given: a malformed payload that fails decoding
cases.expected: the preview shows the refusal with its code; the document is byte-for-byte unchanged; the draft status is invalid

cases.subject: canonical JSON export success
cases.given: Export JSON on a valid chart
cases.expected: the dialog shows byte count and the deterministic filename; on bound delivery success the result says the file was handed to the browser's downloads and the marker advances

cases.subject: lead-sheet text export success
cases.given: Export text on a valid chart
cases.expected: the same delivery honesty and marker settlement for the text format

cases.subject: export refusal shows the code verbatim
cases.given: an export that refuses (for example an over-limit document)
cases.expected: the result surface shows the refusal code verbatim and the next action; no file is pretended

cases.subject: browser rejection never claims disk
cases.expected: the surface says the browser did not take the file and offers retry; the marker does not advance

cases.subject: dismiss restores focus and keeps state
cases.given: the export result dismissed after success
cases.expected: focus restores to the Export trigger; the marker and strip stay settled
